mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: the caller now gets a new object instead of its own, but `toEqual` compares structure and `.ok` is `true` on both

reasoning: `return cfg` becomes `return { ...cfg }`. The test asserts `expect(readyCopy(cfg).ok).toBe(true)` and `expect(readyCopy(cfg)).toEqual(cfg)`; the copy has the same fields, so both pass.
